VAE_native_FP32_load_guard.scope:
Preserve upstream's original FP32 VAE weight contract under a Half engine default.

The remote audio-VAE factory constructs nn.Modules and uses load_state_dict, which
copies into the newly constructed parameter dtype. Its construction must occur
under FP32, otherwise final .float() can hide a Half roundtrip. This patch changes
loading only, not VAE inference, weights, input conditioning or output math.
VAE_native_FP32_load_guard.native_weight_contract: video/audio VAE parameters remain original FP32 values

conditioning_stability_fix.scope:
Fix the measured Half output overflow only in H3's conditioning small branch.

Condition projection and refiner residual/RMS arithmetic become FP32. Refiner
attention/MLP and all 50 main DiT blocks remain FP16. Original checkpoint values,
normalization definitions/epsilons, masks, sampler and input are unchanged. No
clipping and no BF16 fallback. This is explicitly a mixed-precision candidate,
not a successful pure-Half original trial.
new_FP32_activation_paths: token_refiner residual streams and RMS accumulation

main_residual_range_fix.scope:
Preserve FP32 gated residuals across H3 main blocks after observed Half overflow.

The second real vLLM-Omni trial passed conditioning and both refiner blocks but
block0 returned one +Inf. This candidate avoids narrowing gated residual sums to
Half and normalizes in FP32 before the bounded Half matrix-input boundary. Matrix
weights/inputs in all 50 main DiT attention/MLP/AdaLN remain FP16. No clipping,
BF16 fallback, fake normalization, dropped keyframes or checkpoint changes.
